shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd; if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,240p' ../round-brief.md; fi; sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md; sed -n '1,260p' ../ticket.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch; sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts; sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts; sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md; sed -n '1,200p' .lore/test-commands.yml; rg -n \"Tool input validation failed|instancePath|required|should be\" src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts package.json"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "node -e \"const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(p.scripts.test)\"; sed -n '1,180p' scripts/lore-run-test.mjs; sed -n '1,180p' jest.config.*"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'timeout 300 node scripts/lore-run-test.mjs "src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts::ToolRegistry input validation escapes JSON Pointer-reserved characters in nested required-property paths"'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'NODE_OPTIONS="${NODE_OPTIONS:-} --experimental-vm-modules" timeout 300 npx jest --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts -t '"'"'^ToolRegistry input validation escapes JSON Pointer-reserved characters in nested required-property paths$'"' --coverage=false --runInBand"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md; if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; fi; git diff --check; git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git commit -m "Fix tool validation error paths" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD; git status --short --branch'
